title: Ordinary test or edge case?
instruction: You are testing Pong. Sort the tests: an ordinary situation, or a tricky edge?

items.text: The ball flies into the paddle at medium speed
items.why: This is how the game is played all the time. It must work, but bugs rarely hide here.
Zero is a classic edge: does the game get stuck?

items.text: The ball flies at the highest possible speed
items.why: The maximum: this is where the ball skips the paddle.

items.text: The player has three lives and loses one
items.why: An ordinary round of the game.

items.text: The player loses their last life
items.why: The switch to game over. Does the score appear, or does the game crash?

items.text: The ball hits exactly the corner of the court
items.why: In the corner two walls meet at once, and that’s where bounce rules often fail.
Empty is an edge: what does the game show when nobody is there?

debrief: Ordinary tests pass almost every time. Bugs hide at the edges: zero, the maximum, the corner and unexpected input.
